description.value: The Iron Horse Pub & Grill is a community institution in Lone Butte, BC, serving the South Cariboo for over 20 years and continuing under new management. Situated directly on Highway 24 about 10 minutes east of the Cariboo Highway (Hwy 97), it offers a family-friendly atmosphere with a full dine-in menu and take-out service. For cyclists riding the Hwy 24 corridor through this rural stretch of the Interior, it stands as one of the few substantial meal stops along the route.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetch succeeded and confirms an active, dine-in and take-out pub/grill at 6046 Hwy 24, Lone Butte BC, phone (250) 395-2626. The site explicitly advertises take-out ('DINE IN ORDERS TO GO AT FULL MENU PRICES' and a dedicated take-out number), supporting that amenity as true. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenities appears in the website content, so all are set to null. The OSM name ('Iron Horse Pub') differs from the website's consistent usage of 'Iron Horse Pub & Grill', which is flagged as a concern.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the business as 'Iron Horse Pub' but the website consistently uses 'Iron Horse Pub & Grill'.
OSM record lacks phone and address fields; both were sourced from the website only, so contact_confirmed for those fields is null.
URL discovery confidence was rated 'medium'; website content clearly matches the OSM location and name, reducing this concern.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A long-established pub and grill on Hwy 24 in rural Lone Butte where services are sparse; confirmed take-out makes it practical for cyclists on the move, and its location on a touring corridor gives it clear directory value.
